summary: The r450k marketing site (r450k/) gained full multi-language support and true multilingual SEO with build-time prerendering. Site copy was migrated from the single r450k/src/content.js file to per-locale modules (src/content/en.js, ms.js, zh.js, ar.js); English is the authoritative source of structure, with non-English files deriving from it. A new r450k/src/i18n/ module (LangProvider, useLang, useContent, LANGS, localePath, localeFromPath) drives URL-path-based locale detection: English lives at /, Malay at /ms/, Chinese at /zh/, and Arabic at /ar/. All section components were updated to read copy via useContent() rather than importing content.js. An inline language switcher (LangDropdown) renders real <a href> links to per-locale paths (crawlable without JS) with a JS intercept for no-reload switching. Selecting Arabic flips <html dir> to rtl, with src/styles.css RTL overrides for layout. The npm run build script now runs three steps: Vite client build, a Vite SSR build of src/entry-server.jsx, and node scripts/prerender.mjs, which emits a fully populated HTML file per locale — each with the correct <html lang/dir>, translated <title>/meta, canonical, og:url, and hreflang alternates for all four locales plus x-default. public/sitemap.xml was updated to list all four locale URLs with hreflang entries. dist-ssr/ is gitignored.
compatibility: No impact on existing installs or the Go backend — the r450k/ directory is a separate Node project and is never bundled into the Go binary or Docker image. The Cloudflare Workers build command (npm run build) now takes longer due to the SSR step; a build:client script is available for the client-only bundle when the prerender step is not needed. The change adds a build-time dependency on Node's renderToString (React 18 server rendering) but no new runtime npm packages.
